paper.title: Aligning Human Sense: Calibrated Distributional Reward Learning for Video Generation
paper.abstract: Video generation is central to AI-powered content creation. Aligning generated videos with human preferences is a key criterion for evaluating generation quality. Despite significant progress in visual quality, three key challenges remain. First, the reliability of reward signals is constrained by the quality of human preference data, which is often affected by subjective noise and bias. Second, standard scalar reward models collapse multi-aspect human preferences into a single value, leading to

summary.core_problem: 提升视频生成模型与人类偏好的对齐，尤其处理偏好数据噪声、多维偏好冲突和标量 reward 信息损失。
summary.importance: 贡献是视频生成的偏好建模与奖励学习方法。它和 LLM 预训练距离较远，但 reward calibration、distributional reward 和偏好结构约束对多模态 RLHF 有可迁移思路。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 preference-aware learning framework：先用 elite-guided filtering 校准偏好数据，降低主观噪声和偏差；再用分布式奖励建模保留多维人类偏好的权衡，而不是压缩为单个标量；并在 policy optimization 中尝试比局部 KL 约束更能反映偏好全局结构的约束机制。摘要未完整展开最后一部分的具体数学形式。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明目标是用于视频生成偏好对齐，但未给出模型、数据规模、偏好标注规模、baseline、自动指标或人评提升。需要正文确认 reward 模型是否真的带来稳定生成改进。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to align video generation with human preferences while handling noisy preference data, multi-aspect trade-offs, and information loss from scalar rewards.
summary_en.importance: This is a preference learning contribution for video generation. It is not central to LLM pretraining, but reward calibration, distributional reward modeling, and preference-structure constraints may transfer to multimodal RLHF.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed preference-aware framework first applies elite-guided filtering to calibrate preference data and reduce subjective noise. It then models rewards distributionally to preserve trade-offs across preference dimensions instead of collapsing them into a scalar, and revisits policy optimization constraints beyond local KL to better capture global preference structure. The abstract does not fully specify the final mathematical form.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract frames the method for video generation preference alignment but does not provide model details, dataset size, preference annotation scale, baselines, automatic metrics, or human-evaluation gains. The full paper is needed to assess whether the reward model improves generation reliably.

recommendation.zh: 思路可迁移到多模态 RLHF；摘要缺实验数字，先当 reward 建模备忘录。
recommendation.en: The idea may transfer to multimodal RLHF, but the abstract lacks numbers; treat it as a reward-modeling note for now.

paper.title: On the Role of Citations in Preference Data
paper.abstract: Many NLP tasks require systems to provide attribution in their outputs--i.e. citations to grounding sources. Attribution serves as a bulwark against model hallucination and as a means for users to verify the credibility of model outputs. Yet, it is unclear how humans and LLMs evaluate citations when comparing outputs, a process central to reward modeling and modern LLM post-training. This paper studies the role of citations in the preferences of human judges and four open-source LLMs within the

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究一个很具体但容易被忽略的问题：在带引用的科学问答偏好数据中，人类和 LLM judge 到底如何看待 citation。核心不是判断答案是否事实正确，而是分析 citation count、citation diversity、citation age、citation mismatch 等可解释特征，会怎样影响 pairwise preference。这个问题直接关系到 RAG、deep research 和 reward model 训练，因为偏好标签可能把“引用形式”误当成“回答质量”。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是一篇核心论文，但对 post-train 数据质量和 reward modeling 有清晰启发。偏好数据里 citation 是一个强混杂因素：模型可能学到“多引用更可信”或“少而分散的引用更好”这类表面规则，而不是学到 grounded reasoning。论文的价值在于把 citation 从一个展示格式问题，转成了可量化的 preference bias 问题。对于训练研究型助手、RAG judge、citation-aware reward model，这类分析可以帮助设计更干净的标注协议和 reward 特征。贡献量级偏分析型，不是新训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上，作者没有训练新模型，而是用 mixed-effects logistic regression 分析 pairwise preference。模型形式接近 Bradley-Terry：把两个回答之间的偏好作为二分类因变量，把 citation 相关特征作为固定效应，并引入随机效应来处理样本分组带来的相关性。这样做的好处是可以把“同一个问题下不同回答的比较”与全局 citation 特征影响拆开，避免只看简单相关。论文关注的 citation 特征包括：Shannon entropy 衡量的 citation diversity、citation count、SciArena 中的 citation age，以及 ResearchQA 中的 citation mismatch。作者还让四个开源 LLM judge 对同一批 pairwise 样本打分，并对调回答顺序控制 position bias。与常见的 LLM-as-a-judge 论文不同，这里重点不是提高 judge 准确率，而是解释 judge 的偏好结构，并比较它和人类偏好的差异。
summary.experiments: 实验使用两个科学问答偏好数据集。SciArena 有 12,249 个 human pairwise comparisons；ResearchQA 可用比较较小，只有 169 个。LLM judge 包括 Llama3.3-70B、Gemma3-27B、Qwen3-30B 和 Skywork-Critic-70B。为控制展示顺序，每个 pair 做两个 response ordering，因此每个 LLM 在 SciArena 上产生 24,498 次判断，在 ResearchQA 上产生 338 次判断。主要发现有三点：第一，人类更偏好 citation 来源更分散的回答，但并不偏好多引用，甚至倾向于较少引用。第二，LLM judge 对 citation 特征和非 citation 特征的权重与人类不同，有些 citation 相关偏好更强。第三，不同 LLM judge 之间的相关模式差异明显，专门训练为 reward model 的 Skywork-Critic 与通用模型并不只是能力强弱关系，而是偏好结构也不同。由于 ResearchQA 样本量很小，相关结论更适合作为提示，不宜过度外推。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25 分钟。优先看 General Setup，弄清楚两个数据集、四个 judge、order swap 和 mixed-effects model 的设定。然后看各数据集的回归结果表，重点关注 citation diversity 和 citation count 的系数方向，而不是只看总体 agreement。Appendix 中的 judge prompt 也值得扫一眼，因为 citation 偏好很可能受到 prompt 中“引用可靠性”措辞影响。最值得深挖的是：如果把这类 citation 特征显式加入 reward model 或 judge calibration，是否能减少 RAG 场景下的格式奖励和引用堆砌。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how citations affect pairwise preferences in scientific QA. The central question is not whether an answer is factually correct, but whether interpretable citation features such as citation count, citation diversity, citation age, and citation mismatch systematically shift human and LLM-judge preferences. This matters because preference labels for RAG and research-assistant systems may encode citation-format biases rather than grounded answer quality.
summary_en.importance: This is not a core pretraining paper, but it is useful for understanding post-training data quality and reward modeling. Citations can act as a confounder in preference data: a reward model may learn that certain citation patterns look credible instead of learning to reward faithful grounding. The paper’s contribution is analytical. It turns citation behavior from a presentation issue into a measurable preference-bias issue. The main relevance is for citation-aware reward models, LLM-as-a-judge pipelines, and data collection protocols for deep-research assistants.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors use mixed-effects logistic regression for pairwise preference analysis. The setup follows a Bradley-Terry-style view of binary comparisons: the dependent variable is which response wins, while citation-related variables are predictors. Mixed effects are used to handle grouped structure in the data rather than relying on flat correlations. Citation diversity is measured with Shannon entropy over cited sources; citation count captures the total number of citations; citation age is used for SciArena; citation mismatch is used for ResearchQA. The authors then run four open-weight LLM judges on the same examples, with both response orders, to control for presentation-order bias. The main distinction from typical LLM-as-a-judge work is that the paper focuses on explaining the judge’s preference structure rather than maximizing judge accuracy.
summary_en.experiments: The analysis uses two scientific QA preference datasets. SciArena contains 12,249 human pairwise comparisons. ResearchQA is much smaller, with 169 available comparisons. The LLM judges are Llama3.3-70B, Gemma3-27B, Qwen3-30B, and Skywork-Critic-70B. Each pair is judged under both response orderings, producing 24,498 judgments per LLM on SciArena and 338 per LLM on ResearchQA. The main findings are: humans tend to prefer more diverse citations but fewer citations overall; LLM judges weight citation and non-citation features differently from humans, sometimes with stronger citation-related preferences; and different LLM judges show distinct correlational patterns rather than a simple capability ordering. The ResearchQA results should be read cautiously because the sample size is small.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25 minutes. Start with the general setup to understand the datasets, the four judges, response-order swapping, and the mixed-effects model. Then read the dataset-specific regression tables, focusing on the sign and size of citation diversity and citation count effects. The judge prompt in the appendix is also useful, since prompt wording can directly affect citation preferences. The most useful follow-up question is whether explicit citation-feature calibration can reduce reward hacking by citation stuffing in RAG-oriented reward models.

recommendation.zh: 偏好数据里 citation 是干扰项；只看 mixed-effects 结果即可，适合校准 RM 数据收集规范。
recommendation.en: Citations are a real confounder in preference data; read the mixed-effects results and use them to tighten RM data collection.

paper.title: VA-Judger: Reward Modeling from Human Preference Feedback for Joint Video-Audio Generation
paper.abstract: Using reinforcement learning to post-train joint video-audio generation models requires a reward signal. Existing methods construct this reward by combining metrics for individual quality dimensions, including audio quality, visual fidelity, and synchronization. However, these metrics evaluate perceptual dimensions separately and fail to capture the overall semantic and temporal coherence among the text prompt, video, and audio that shapes human preferences. Optimizing models against these metri

summary.core_problem: 为联合视频-音频生成模型提供更符合人类偏好的奖励信号，避免单独优化画质、音质和同步指标带来的 reward hacking。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成的偏好数据、reward model 与评测基准。它对视频-音频生成的 RL 后训练有直接意义，也对多模态 reward 设计有借鉴，但不直接推进 LLM 预训练。
summary.technical_approach: 构建 VAPref-10K 人类偏好数据集，包含来自开源生成模型的提示和成对比较；提出 VA-Judger，用人类偏好反馈训练联合视频-音频 reward model，使其同时评估文本提示、视频和音频之间的语义一致性与时间一致性。另提出 VA-Judger-Bench，用于评估 reward model 在域内和域外模型比较上的泛化。
summary.experiments: 数据集包含 9K prompts 和 10.3K 细粒度成对偏好比较。摘要说明评测覆盖域内与域外生成模型比较，但未给出 reward model 规模、训练细节、baseline 名称或相对提升数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper builds reward modeling for joint video-audio generation so that optimization better matches human preference rather than separate audio, visual, or synchronization metrics.
summary_en.importance: This is a multimodal generation reward-modeling and preference-data contribution. It is relevant to RL post-training for video-audio generators and to multimodal reward design, but it does not directly advance LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors construct VAPref-10K, a human-preference dataset with prompts and pairwise comparisons from open-source generation models. They train VA-Judger as a reward model over text prompts, video, and audio, targeting semantic and temporal coherence jointly. VA-Judger-Bench evaluates in-domain and out-of-domain model comparisons.
summary_en.experiments: VAPref-10K contains 9K prompts and 10.3K fine-grained pairwise comparisons. The benchmark covers both in-domain and out-of-domain comparisons, but the abstract does not specify reward-model size, full baselines, or exact improvement margins.

recommendation.zh: 多模态 reward hacking 的问题设定干净；若做生成模型 RL，只看偏好标注 schema 和 OOD judge 设计。
recommendation.en: The reward-hacking setup is clean; if working on RL for generators, read the preference schema and OOD judge design.

paper.title: From Refuse to Richness: Rubric Rewards for Long-Form Hallucination Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Rewards that penalize unsupported claims can improve grounding in long-form generation, but they can also teach models to answer less. We study this refusal-to-richness trade-off in long-form hallucination RL. Instead of using global richness proxies such as length, claim count, detail, or pairwise relevance, we represent each question with a key-point rubric that specifies the required and optional information a useful answer should cover. These rubrics define coverage directly and are used bot

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是长文本幻觉 RL 里的一个老问题，但切得更具体：如果奖励只强调 grounding，模型很容易学会“少说少错”，答案变短、覆盖变差；如果只鼓励丰富度，又会把 unsupported 内容带回来。作者要解决的是如何在长答案训练中同时保住支持性和信息覆盖，而且覆盖不是用长度、claim 数这类粗代理，而是按题目定制的 key-point rubric 来定义。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是直接贡献，更偏 post-train / RL 信号设计，但和 pretrain 接口关系很紧。原因在于：这类工作揭示了奖励函数如何系统性改变模型的输出分布，尤其是把模型推向保守拒答还是完整作答。对做持续预训练、mid-training、合成监督信号、reward modeling 的人都有参考价值。真正有启发的点不是“rubric 比长度好”这么简单，而是说明长文本 RL 里需要把‘内容覆盖’显式结构化，否则 grounding reward 会诱导出错误的最优策略。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是把 richness 从全局代理变量改成 per-sample checklist。作者定义 rubric 不是参考答案，而是问题特定的信息清单，分 required 和 optional key points，并配一个一句话 completeness summary。模型回答的 richness 用 rubric coverage 来打分；grounding 则用句子级支持性信号，文中统一把 factuality 和 faithfulness 都纳入 grounding。

论文比较了五类奖励，核心差别在于 grounding、rubric coverage 和 pairwise relevance 三种信号如何组合。文中强调几种组合方式的行为差异：纯 grounding 奖励会强烈压缩输出；纯 rubric 奖励能提高覆盖，但会放松支持性；乘法式 gating 会继承 grounding 的保守缺点；简单加法能缓解但不完全；一个“软组合”——非 gating 的 grounding 项 + rubric coverage + pairwise relevance——在当前实验里给出最平衡的结果。

rubric 的构建也有方法细节。作者不是让单个模型写 rubric，而是用多生成器 union pipeline：先由 GPT-5.4 和 Gemini-3-Flash-Preview 独立生成候选 rubric，再由 GPT-OSS-120B 合并、去重，得到最终版本。这样做是为了减少单一 rubric writer 的遗漏，并把覆盖面做宽，但同时限制 rubric 大小，避免 judge 成本过高。训练数据方面，RL pool 共 4K prompts，其中 2K 是带 context 的 grounded prompts，2K 是来自 WildChat 的 open prompts，用来避免模型只在 reference-grounded 场景里学会保守策略。

从方法取舍看，这篇论文的关键不是更强的 RL 算法，而是 reward specification。它把“有用的长答案”拆成两个可分离目标：句子是否被支持，以及问题要求的信息是否被覆盖。相比长度、claim count、detail reward，这种定义更接近真实用户需求，也更容易解释 reward trade-off 为什么出现。
summary.experiments:
实验在两个开源模型家族上做：Qwen3-4B 和 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B。作者控制变量比较严格：同一 base checkpoint、同一 prompt pool、同一 rollout 配置、同一评测切分和 judge，只换 reward。

训练集是 4,000 个 RL prompts：2,000 个 grounded prompts 带 context，来自已有 reliability-oriented pool；2,000 个 open prompts 来自 WildChat。评测覆盖 FACTS Grounding、LongFact、FActScore closed-book / open-book，以及 CL-bench 这类 checklist 风格任务，还看 creative-writing 和 pairwise preference 之类的 OOD 行为。

主要实验结论很稳定。第一，FACT-ONLY 这类严格 grounding reward 会在很少的 RL steps 内显著缩短回答，模型学到的策略是通过少答来规避 unsupported claims。第二，RUBRIC-ONLY 能更好保持 coverage，尤其在 checklist completion 和开放式写作上迁移更好，但 grounding 会下降。第三，硬 gating 的 fact-rubric 组合在 OOD 上仍然偏弱，因为 gating 机制保留了“宁可不说”的偏好。第四，soft three-component reward 在 in-distribution grounding 与 OOD completion / preference 之间取得更平衡的结果。

从全文摘录能确认的硬数字主要是模型规模和训练集规模。摘要没有给出完整分数表，因此这里不虚构具体提升幅度。更重要的实验洞察是 reward 形状决定了策略形状：一旦 grounding 以全有或全无的方式进入目标，模型就容易把 refusal 当成最稳妥解。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议先看 Introduction 里对 refusal-to-richness trade-off 的定义，再看 reward design 那一节，弄清楚 rubric coverage、grounding 和 pairwise relevance 各自约束什么。之后直接看主结果表，重点不是谁分数最高，而是不同 reward 组合在 ID grounding 与 OOD checklist / creative writing 上的方向性差异。

如果只花 25 分钟，建议看四处：1）rubric 的形式化定义；2）五种 reward 的公式或表格；3）FACT-ONLY 导致回答长度快速下降的训练曲线；4）OOD 评测结果。值得深挖的点有三个：一是 rubric 作为 reward 是否会过拟合 rubric writer 的偏好；二是多生成器 union 是否足够稳定；三是这种 reward 设计能否迁移到 reasoning RL、RAG answer generation，甚至 continual post-training。对做 pretrain 接口的人，最有用的启发是：训练信号如果只惩罚错误，不奖励完整性，模型会自然收缩输出支持域。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a specific failure mode in long-form hallucination RL: if the reward focuses too much on grounding, the model learns to say less; if the reward focuses too much on richness, unsupported content comes back. The proposed fix is to define richness not with global proxies such as length or claim count, but with question-specific key-point rubrics that measure whether the answer actually covers what the prompt asks for.
summary_en.importance: This is more post-training than pretraining, but it is highly relevant to the pretrain–posttrain interface because it shows how reward design reshapes the output distribution. The useful lesson is not merely that rubrics beat length. It is that long-form RL needs an explicit notion of information coverage; otherwise grounding rewards induce the wrong optimum, namely conservative under-answering. That matters for RLHF/RLAIF, synthetic supervision, continual post-training, and any setup where reliability and completeness must coexist.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The main idea is to replace generic richness proxies with per-sample checklists. A rubric is not a reference answer. It is a structured list of required and optional key points for a given question, plus a one-sentence completeness summary. The model’s richness is scored by rubric coverage, while grounding is scored with a sentence-level support signal. The paper uses “grounding” broadly to cover both faithfulness to provided context and factual support from reliable world knowledge.

The study compares five reward variants built from three ingredients: grounding, rubric coverage, and pairwise relevance. The important result is that the composition matters as much as the ingredients. Pure grounding rewards improve support but push the model toward shorter, safer answers. Pure rubric rewards preserve coverage but weaken support. Multiplicative gating inherits the conservatism of grounding-heavy objectives. Simple additive combinations help but only partially. The best balance in their experiments comes from a soft three-term reward: a non-gating grounding term plus rubric coverage plus pairwise relevance.

Rubric construction is also part of the contribution. Instead of relying on a single rubric writer, the authors use a multi-generator union pipeline: GPT-5.4 and Gemini-3-Flash-Preview independently draft candidate rubrics, and GPT-OSS-120B merges and deduplicates them into a final union rubric. The goal is to reduce omissions from any single generator while keeping the rubric compact enough for practical judging. The RL training pool contains 4k prompts, split evenly between grounded prompts with context and open prompts from WildChat, so the model does not learn a purely reference-grounded, refusal-heavy policy.

Methodologically, this is less about a new RL algorithm and more about reward specification. The paper cleanly separates two objectives that are often conflated in long-form generation: whether each sentence is supported, and whether the answer covers the information the question demands.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments use two open-weight model families: Qwen3-4B and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B. The comparison is controlled carefully: same base checkpoint, same prompt pool, same rollout setup, same evaluation splits, same judges; only the reward changes.

Training uses 4,000 RL prompts: 2,000 grounded prompts with context from a reliability-oriented pool, and 2,000 open prompts from WildChat. Evaluation covers FACTS Grounding, LongFact, FActScore closed-book and open-book, CL-bench-style checklist tasks, and out-of-distribution settings such as creative writing and pairwise preference.

The main findings are consistent. First, strict grounding-only rewards quickly shorten responses within a small number of RL steps, showing that the model discovers refusal or under-answering as the safest way to avoid unsupported claims. Second, rubric-only rewards preserve coverage much better, especially on checklist completion and open-ended writing, but grounding degrades. Third, hard fact-rubric gating remains weak out of distribution because it preserves the same conservative bias. Fourth, the soft three-component reward gives the best trade-off between in-distribution grounding and out-of-distribution completion / preference behavior.

The excerpt provides the key setup numbers but not the full score tables, so it would be unsafe to invent exact gains. The important experimental lesson is structural: the shape of the reward determines the shape of the learned policy, and all-or-nothing grounding terms naturally favor saying less.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction, especially the refusal-to-richness trade-off. Then read the reward design section carefully, because the paper lives or dies on how grounding, rubric coverage, and pairwise relevance are defined and combined. After that, go straight to the main result tables. The key is not a single best score, but the directional pattern across in-distribution grounding and out-of-distribution checklist / creative-writing behavior.

A 25-minute skim should focus on four things: 1) the formal definition of rubric coverage, 2) the table or formulas for the five reward variants, 3) the training curve showing response length collapse under FACT-ONLY RL, and 4) the OOD evaluation results. The most interesting follow-up questions are whether the reward overfits to rubric-writer preferences, how stable the multi-generator union pipeline is, and whether the same reward design transfers to reasoning RL, RAG answer generation, or continual post-training. For readers interested in the pretrain interface, the practical lesson is simple: if the training signal only punishes errors and does not reward completeness, the model will shrink its answer support by default.

recommendation.zh: 读它不是为“又一个RL配方”，而是看 rubric 把 richness 从 proxy 变成可监督目标；重点看 trade-off 曲线与组合权重设定。
recommendation.en: Not about a new RL recipe—rubrics turn “richness” from a proxy into a trainable target; focus on the trade-off curves and how they weight combined rewards.

paper.title: Judging Is Not Enumerating: Silent Omissions in LLM-Authored Acceptable Sets
paper.abstract: Language models are increasingly promoted from examinees to examiners: they write the test suites, answer keys, rubrics, and reward functions that define correctness for other systems. We measure the capability that role assumes and find it lacking under the protocol the role is usually deployed with, one-shot greedy authoring with no test-time reasoning. Across four reference constructions - two with complete finite truth, one with a hardened executable reference (HumanEval+/MBPP+), one with an

summary.core_problem: LLM 正从「被评测者」转向「评测规则的制定者」：生成测试用例、答案要点、评分标准、奖励函数等。论文要回答的核心问题是：模型能否准确构造出一个正确性规范所对应的可接受集合（acceptable set）——也就是它写出来的 verifier 所定义的接受域，和真实的接受域是否一致。
summary.importance: 这一问题直接关系到 RLVR（可验证奖励强化学习）、自动评测、模型生成 rubric 等下游流程的可靠性。如果模型构造的接受域存在系统性遗漏或额外约束，会直接污染奖励信号和评测结果。论文把问题形式化为「执行（membership 判断） vs 创作（构造接受集合）」的能力差距，并区分了外延式（枚举成员）和内涵式（写谓词/测试）两种失败模式，对理解 LLM 作为 judge / reward designer 的边界有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文用四类有完整真值的构造任务来测量：两类是机械可判定的词表谓词（外延式枚举），一类是 HumanEval+/MBPP+ 代码任务（内涵式写测试），还有一类带强化规则的可执行参照。核心测量指标是模型创作的接受域 Ŝ 与真实接受域 S* 的 F1 一致性，并且和同一个模型做 membership 判断的能力做同尺度对比。论文发现的核心机制是「静默遗漏（silent omission）」：自回归模型在枚举集合时，逐个元素生成、决定何时停止，却永远看不到没被采样到的候选，导致接受域系统性偏小。对于存在紧凑规则的任务，测试时推理（test-time reasoning）可以直接补上这个缺口；对于没有显式规则的代码类任务，则需要额外的 probe gating 等补救手段。
summary.experiments: 在机械构造的词表任务上，模型陈述规则（内涵式重述）的 F1 接近 0.99，但外延式枚举的表现显著更低，差距完全来自枚举能力而非理解能力。在代码任务上，模型生成的测试套件同样会遗漏正确解或引入额外约束，导致接受域偏小。论文同时验证了：当规范有紧凑的可重述规则时，test-time reasoning 能基本消除创作与执行之间的差距；没有这种规则时，差距持续存在。
summary.reading_guide: 重点读 §3 的四类构造任务设计和失败模式分析，特别是 §3.7 关于 test-time reasoning 补救的部分，以及 §3.11 关于「模型能说清规则但枚举不全」的对照实验。形式化定义部分（引言后半段）值得快速过一遍，理解 extensional vs intensional authoring 的区分。预计阅读时间 40–60 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: LLMs are increasingly moving from examinees to authors of evaluation specifications: they generate test suites, answer keys, rubrics, and reward functions that define correctness for downstream systems. The paper asks whether models can faithfully materialize the acceptable set denoted by a correctness specification — whether the acceptance region induced by an LLM-authored verifier matches the true acceptance set.
summary_en.importance: This question directly bears on the reliability of RLVR (reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards), automated evaluation, and model-generated rubrics. If the authored acceptance region suffers from systematic omissions or spurious constraints, reward signals and evaluation outcomes become corrupted. The work formalizes the gap between execution (membership judgment) and authoring (constructing the acceptable set), and distinguishes extensional (enumeration) from intensional (predicate / test-suite) failure modes — a useful framing for understanding the limits of LLMs as judges or reward designers.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper builds four reference constructions with complete ground truth to measure fidelity: two mechanically decidable word-list predicates (extensional enumeration), one hardened executable code benchmark (HumanEval+/MBPP+, intensional test authoring), and one additional controlled construction. The core metric is F1 agreement between the authored acceptance region Ŝ and the true set S*, measured on the same candidate space used to score the model's own membership execution. The central failure mechanism identified is silent omission: autoregressive models generate sets element by element and decide when to stop, but never inspect unsampled candidates, so the authored region is systematically too small. Where a compact rule exists, test-time reasoning closes the gap; where it does not, remedies such as probe gating are required.
summary_en.experiments: On mechanical word-list constructions, restating the rule as an executable predicate reaches near-perfect F1 (~0.99), while extensional enumeration performs substantially worse — the gap comes from enumeration ability, not understanding. On code tasks, model-generated test suites also miss valid solutions or introduce extra constraints, shrinking the acceptance region. Test-time reasoning largely eliminates the authoring-vs-execution gap when a compact restatable rule is available, but not otherwise.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3, especially the four construction designs and failure-mode analysis; §3.7 on test-time reasoning as a remedy; and §3.11 on the contrast between rule-stating and enumeration. The formal framing of extensional vs intensional authoring in the latter half of the introduction is worth a quick pass. Estimated reading time: 40–60 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 应读实验表；它会降低你对 LLM 自动写 reward/test suite 的信任，尤其是开放答案集合场景。
recommendation.en: Read the experimental tables; this should lower confidence in LLM-authored rewards and test suites for open acceptable sets.

paper.title: Memory Reward Inflation in Self-Improving LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Self-improving LLM agents increasingly learn from experience without updating any weights. Each episode is stored in an external memory, scored, and retrieved for similar future tasks to shape later behavior. Viewed through a reward lens, the stored score is a proxy reward for an implicit, non-parametric policy. Each retrieved episode then becomes a policy-improvement step whose reliability hinges on how that score is produced. In deployment, ground-truth labels are unavailable, so the stored re

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究的是 memory-based self-improving agent 里的一个失真源：agent 不更新参数，而是把过往 episode 写入外部记忆库，并用一个分数决定哪些记忆会被未来检索和复用。问题在于，部署环境通常没有真实标签，这个分数只能由 LLM 自评或近似 judge 给出。论文指出，这会产生系统性的 reward inflation：错误 episode 可能被高分写入，并在后续被反复检索，形成作者称为 Echo Gap 的正反馈回路。核心问题不是一般性的 judge 噪声，而是“被高估的错误经验会持续进入策略循环并放大”。
summary.importance: 它和预训练不是直接同一层问题，但和 pretrain↔post-train 接口、reward 信号质量、无标签自改进都有直接关系。对基座研究员更重要的启发是：只要学习信号来自模型自身评估，而不是外部可校验反馈，就要警惕 reward hacking 从一次性偏差变成持久性记忆污染。这个结论对 memory agent、RLAIF、self-training、合成偏好数据都有参考意义。论文的贡献主要在诊断和机制刻画，而不是提出一个通用强方法。
summary.technical_approach:
技术上分三层。第一层是现象定义。作者把 memory retrieval 看成一种隐式、非参数化 policy，memory score 则对应 proxy reward。这样一来，写入高分记忆并在相似任务上复用，就等价于在一个外部记忆空间里做 policy improvement。Echo Gap 指的是：自评奖励与真实成功之间存在系统偏差，而且这种偏差与未来检索频率相关，因此会被动态放大。

第二层是理论诊断。论文提出 Error-Independence Assumption, EIA，用来刻画“更强的 verifier 为什么不一定能纠偏”。如果 verifier 的误差与原始 self-grade 的偏差高度相关，那么即便 verifier 平均更准，也无法对具体 memory 做有效去膨胀。作者把可恢复收益写成依赖两个量的函数：一是 verifier score 与真实效用的一致性，二是 verifier error 与原始 bias 的去相关程度。这里的关键判断很实用：纠偏不只需要更高能力，还需要不同错误模式。

第三层是缓解方法。作者反对 label-blind 的全局 calibration，因为全局映射只能重标定分数分布，无法识别“哪条记忆被高估”。他们主张 per-memory demotion，即对每条 memory 用额外、尽量去相关的信号做个体化降权。文中还给出一种 answer-free de-inflation 方案，并在 Memento 风格的 retrieve–inject–write agent 上验证。这里“answer-free”强调的是不依赖真实标签，而是利用与原始自评不同的信息通道来修正写回分数。
summary.experiments:
实验分成两部分。第一部分看 memory bank 本身的分数失真。作者在多个模型家族和 live factual banks 上观察到，错误 episode 会被系统性高估，而且这种高估与被复用频率相关，不是简单的随机噪声。更强的 re-grader 往往整体更接近真实标签，但其错误仍可能和原始 self-grade 偏差同向，因此无法稳定修正 bank 排序。

第二部分看端到端行为后果。作者在 BIRD text-to-SQL 上搭建了一个较忠实的 Memento-style memory loop：agent 检索相似历史、注入上下文、完成当前任务、再把新 episode 写回记忆库，且写回时不访问真实标签。评测则用 benchmark 官方 execution accuracy。结果是，自评写回会逐步污染 memory bank，而提出的 de-inflation 方法在多随机种子下都优于 self-graded baseline，说明 Echo Gap 不只是评分层面的统计现象，而会转化为真实行为退化。

从摘要和正文片段能确认的重点，是现象稳定存在、理论条件与实证一致、以及 mitigation 在真实 memory loop 中有效。现有片段没有完整表格和精确数值，无法可靠给出提升点数或误差幅度，因此不应虚构具体数字。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先抓住作者的建模视角：memory score 不是普通 metadata，而是代理奖励。理解这一点后，再看 Echo Gap 的定义和 Theorem 1，重点不是公式本身，而是“为什么错误高分会在检索闭环里乘法式放大”。

然后看 EIA 那一节。这里是全文最有信息量的部分，因为它解释了为什么“换一个更强 judge”常常不够。实验部分建议优先看两类图表：1）memory score 与真实正确性的偏差分布；2）端到端 BIRD agent 在不同写回策略下的 execution accuracy 变化。若只做泛读，30 分钟左右足够；若关心 RLAIF、self-training 或 memory agent 的训练信号问题，EIA 和 de-inflation 细节值得细看。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a failure mode in memory-based self-improving LLM agents. These agents do not update model weights; instead, they store past episodes in external memory, assign each episode a utility score, and retrieve high-scoring similar episodes for future tasks. In deployment, ground-truth labels are usually unavailable, so the stored utility is produced by self-grading or an LLM judge. The core problem is that incorrect episodes can receive inflated rewards, get written into memory, and then be preferentially reused, creating a persistent feedback loop. The paper calls this phenomenon the Echo Gap.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it is highly relevant to the quality of learning signals in post-training and self-improvement pipelines. The main lesson for foundation-model research is that once model-generated evaluation is used as a reward proxy, reward hacking can become persistent memory corruption rather than a one-off grading error. That matters for memory agents, RLAIF, self-training, synthetic preference generation, and any setup where future behavior is shaped by model-produced scores without external verification.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper has three technical layers. First, it reframes memory retrieval as an implicit non-parametric policy and the stored utility score as a proxy reward. Under this view, writing high-scoring episodes and reusing them later is a form of policy improvement in memory space. The Echo Gap is then defined as a systematic mismatch between self-assessed reward and true success, amplified by retrieval frequency.

Second, the paper provides a diagnosis through the Error-Independence Assumption (EIA). The key claim is that a stronger verifier is not sufficient if its errors are correlated with the original self-grading bias. The recoverable benefit of correction depends on two quantities: how well verifier scores align with true utility, and how decorrelated verifier errors are from the original bias. This is the most useful conceptual contribution: correction requires not just more capability, but a different error channel.

Third, the paper proposes mitigation through per-memory de-inflation rather than global calibration. A label-blind global remapping of scores cannot identify which specific memories are overvalued. Instead, the authors argue for memory-specific demotion using auxiliary signals that are less likely to share the same bias. They instantiate this idea with an answer-free de-inflation method and test it in a Memento-style retrieve–inject–write loop.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are split into bank-level diagnosis and end-to-end behavioral impact. At the memory-bank level, the paper shows that incorrect episodes are systematically over-rewarded across the studied model families and factual memory banks, and that the inflation correlates with future reuse. This is not mere random judge noise. More capable re-graders are often better on average, but their residual errors can still align with the original self-grading bias, which limits their corrective value.

At the agent level, the paper evaluates a faithful memory loop on BIRD text-to-SQL. The agent retrieves similar past episodes, injects them into context, solves the current task, and writes the new episode back without access to ground-truth labels at write time. Final evaluation uses official execution accuracy. The reported result is that self-graded write-back progressively corrupts the memory bank, while the proposed de-inflation method consistently improves over the self-graded baseline across random seeds. This shows that the Echo Gap is not only a scoring artifact; it translates into measurable behavioral degradation.

The provided content supports the qualitative findings and the structure of the empirical evidence, but it does not expose complete tables or trustworthy exact numbers. It would therefore be inappropriate to fabricate precise gains.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Begin with the framing: memory scores are treated as proxy rewards, not just metadata. That lens makes the rest of the paper much easier to follow. Then read the Echo Gap definition and the theorem around multiplicative amplification in retrieval loops. The important point is not the formalism itself, but why inflated mistakes become self-reinforcing.

Next, focus on the EIA section. This is the conceptual center of the paper because it explains why replacing self-grading with a stronger LLM judge often fails. In the experiments, prioritize the plots that compare stored utility against true correctness and the end-to-end BIRD results under different write-back strategies. A useful skim should take around 30 minutes. If you work on RLAIF, self-training, or memory-based agents, the EIA analysis and the de-inflation mechanism deserve a closer read.

recommendation.zh: 值得看失败案例和 judge 相关性分析；它提醒 memory self-improvement 不是免费 RL，奖励噪声会被检索放大。
recommendation.en: Read the failure cases and judge-correlation analysis; it treats memory self-improvement as non-free RL where reward noise is amplified by retrieval.

paper.title: Learning Latent Reasoning Traces for Scalar Reward Models End-to-End
paper.abstract: Reward models (RMs) are central to aligning large language models with human preferences via reinforcement learning. Although traditional scalar RMs enable efficient and probabilistic reward modeling, they rely on superficial cues that fail to generalize to complex or out-of-distribution (OOD) tasks. Conversely, generative RMs leverage extensive reasoning to improve robustness on challenging tasks, but their natural language-based scores lack the numerical flexibility and probabilistic interpret

summary.core_problem: 解决标量奖励模型在复杂和分布外任务上依赖表层线索、泛化差的问题，同时避免生成式奖励模型缺乏数值可解释性和概率语义的缺点。
summary.importance: 这属于 pretrain↔post-train 接口上很有价值的一类工作：不是单纯把 RM 做大，而是把“推理痕迹”作为中间潜变量直接为标量奖励服务。它对 reward signal 质量、latent reasoning、以及 RL 阶段如何反哺基础模型都有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 LatentRM，把中间 reasoning traces 建模为离散潜变量，并端到端最大化下游标量奖励的似然，而不是把生成解释和标量打分并行训练。核心点在于：通过 on-policy 优化学习对 reward prediction 真正有用的潜在推理轨迹，使 reasoning 成为标量 RM 的因果中介而非旁路产物。
summary.experiments: 从摘要可知，作者将 LatentRM 与传统 scalar RM、以及生成式 RM/多任务混合范式比较，重点考察复杂任务和 OOD 场景下的鲁棒性与泛化。论文声称在多个 reward modeling 基准上取得更强性能，并提升了对困难样本的判别能力。摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据量和提升幅度，需看正文实验表确认 setup 是否干净、是否控制了推理 token 开销与 on-policy 数据分布变化。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自北京大学与腾讯。腾讯在 reward modeling、对齐和推理增强方向持续有产出；这篇工作也贴近近两年“latent reasoning / hidden CoT for supervision”这条线。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the weakness of scalar reward models on complex and out-of-distribution tasks, while avoiding the loss of numerical interpretability found in generative reward models.
summary_en.importance: This is valuable at the pretrain-posttrain interface. Instead of merely scaling reward models, it treats reasoning traces as latent variables optimized specifically for scalar reward prediction. That has implications for reward-signal quality, latent reasoning, and how RL-stage supervision feeds back into foundation models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose LatentRM, which models intermediate reasoning traces as discrete latent variables and optimizes them end-to-end for downstream scalar reward likelihood. Rather than jointly training free-form explanations and scalar scores in parallel, the method uses on-policy optimization so that the learned latent reasoning actually benefits scalar reward prediction.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, LatentRM is compared against standard scalar RMs and generative or multitask reward-modeling baselines, with emphasis on robustness and generalization on hard and OOD tasks. The paper claims stronger performance on multiple reward-modeling benchmarks and better discrimination on challenging examples. The abstract does not provide model sizes, dataset scale, or exact margins, so the full paper is needed to judge whether the setup cleanly controls for reasoning-token budget and on-policy distribution shift.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Peking University and Tencent. Tencent has been active in reward modeling, alignment, and reasoning-related post-training, and this paper fits the recent line of latent or hidden reasoning supervision.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得认真看：它在修正“RM 只需更强表征或更长解释”的 prior，建议先核查 latent trace 是否真带来 OOD 增益，而不是被 on-policy 数据分布偷了分。
recommendation.en: This is worth a careful read: it challenges the prior that reward models only need better representations or longer explanations; first verify whether the latent trace truly drives OOD gains rather than borrowing them from on-policy data shift.

paper.title: Inverse RL Helps Align AI by Imitating Humans
paper.abstract: Language model alignment aims to make model behavior reliably reflect desirable properties such as helpfulness, safety, and instruction following. Current approaches typically use supervised fine-tuning on demonstrations or reinforcement learning with rewards derived from verifiers or human feedback. These paradigms leave an important question underexplored: can demonstrations alone yield an implicit reward that can be inspected, reused, and optimized on-policy to align AI? Motivated by inverse

summary.core_problem: 现有对齐范式中，专家演示仅用于监督微调，无法从中恢复出可解释、可审计、可在推理时复用、也可用于策略梯度优化的显式奖励函数；传统逆强化学习方法恢复的奖励通常与策略本身同样黑盒，难以用于对齐场景的可控优化。
summary.importance: 提出了仅依赖演示数据、不依赖偏好标注或独立验证器的显式奖励恢复范式；对演示数据利用率低、奖励标注成本高、需要可审计对齐信号的后训练场景有启发，也为从 SFT 数据中二次提取优化信号、衔接 SFT 与 RL 阶段提供了一条新路径。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PARED（Projected Alignment Reward Estimated from Demonstrations）：将每条「上下文-回复」轨迹投影到人工选定的低维语义特征空间（如 helpfulness、harmlessness、topic 坐标，显式排除长度等易被利用的特征），用轻量级逻辑斯蒂判别器区分专家演示分布与当前策略采样分布；判别器输出的「专家相似度分数」直接作为标量奖励 r = log D(φ(τ))。该奖励有两种使用方式：推理时做 best-of-N 重排序，无需额外训练；训练时作为 KL 正则化在线 RL 的奖励信号，并随策略更新定期用最新的 on-policy 样本重新拟合判别器，避免奖励过时。在受众条件对齐场景下，可共享同一个基础策略，为不同目标受众分别训练独立的 PARED 奖励，实现多目标对齐。
summary.experiments: 在受众条件上下文对齐任务上验证：PARED 作为 best-of-N 重排序器即可显著优于基础模型；在 SFT 之后继续应用 PARED 在线 RL 能获得进一步提升，说明演示中仍残留 SFT 未完全提取的优化信号。针对不同受众分别训练的奖励均能带来对应方向的对齐收益，未出现一个受众的提升以另一个受众退化为代价的明显权衡。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读预计 15–25 分钟。重点关注第 2 节的问题形式化与特征投影设计思路、图 1 的整体流程；若关心落地细节可查看判别器特征选择与在线重训练频率的消融实验。核心启发在于「把演示当作分布匹配问题而非单纯模仿学习」的思路，具体实验规模较小，方法本身的可迁移性需要结合自身数据验证。
summary.authors_note: Carnegie Mellon University；通讯作者 Mateusz Wilinski (mwilinsk@cs.cmu.edu)

summary_en.core_problem: In current alignment pipelines, expert demonstrations are used only for supervised fine-tuning and are never distilled into an explicit reward function that is interpretable, auditable, reusable at inference time, or optimizable via policy gradients. Classical inverse RL methods recover rewards that are typically as opaque as the policies themselves, making them unsuitable for controllable alignment.
summary_en.importance: PARED establishes a demonstration-only, explicit-reward recovery paradigm that requires neither preference labels nor an independent verifier. It improves utilization of demonstration data, offers an auditable alignment signal, and opens a new path to extract a second optimization signal from existing SFT corpora, bridging the SFT and RL stages more tightly.
summary_en.technical_approach: PARED (Projected Alignment Reward Estimated from Demonstrations) first projects every context-response trajectory into a practitioner-chosen, low-dimensional semantic feature space (e.g. helpfulness, harmlessness, topic coordinates, with length and other easily exploitable features explicitly excluded). A lightweight logistic discriminator separates the expert-demonstration distribution from the current policy's sample distribution in this feature space; its expert-likeness score is used directly as a scalar reward r = log D(φ(τ)). This reward supports two downstream uses: best-of-N reranking at inference time with no further training, or KL-regularized on-policy RL. As the policy evolves, the discriminator is periodically refit against fresh on-policy samples to avoid reward staleness. In audience-conditioned contextual alignment, a single shared policy can be paired with separate PARED rewards per target audience to support multi-objective alignment.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluations are conducted on audience-conditioned contextual alignment tasks. PARED already outperforms the base model when used only as a best-of-N reranker. When applied as on-policy RL after standard SFT, it delivers further gains, demonstrating that demonstrations carry optimization signal not fully extracted by supervised imitation. Audience-specific rewards each improve alignment on their target audience without a visible degradation on the other audience, showing no obvious zero-sum tradeoff.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time estimate: 15–25 minutes. Focus on Section 2 for problem formalization and the design rationale behind feature projection, and Figure 1 for the end-to-end pipeline. For implementation details, check ablations on feature selection and discriminator refit frequency. The main transferable insight is framing demonstrations as a distribution-matching problem rather than pure imitation; reported experiments are relatively small-scale, so real-world applicability should be validated against one's own data.
summary_en.authors_note: Carnegie Mellon University; corresponding author Mateusz Wilinski (mwilinsk@cs.cmu.edu)

recommendation.zh: 值得看奖励参数化和 on-policy loop；若实验规模小，只能当偏好标注替代方案的弱信号。
recommendation.en: Read the reward parameterization and on-policy loop; if the experiments are small, treat it only as weak evidence for replacing preference labels.

paper.title: Zing: Social Mind for LLMs
paper.abstract: As large language models move from isolated task solving toward long-term service in human environments, they require social intelligence: the ability to infer mental states, track social relations, reason over norms, and adapt behavior under context. This report presents Zhijing, an integrated framework for measuring, internalizing, and grounding social intelligence. For measurement, we introduce SoMBench, a psychology-grounded benchmark spanning 3 primary dimensions, 17 secondary dimensions, a

summary.core_problem: 如何把“社会智能”（心智推断、关系与规范推理、情境化行为）从零散任务评测，推进到可诊断、可训练、可部署支撑的一整套框架；并回答一个更工程化的问题：当模型要长期在社会环境中服务时，哪些社会能力缺口最关键、如何补、如何在推理时稳定落地。
summary.importance:
对基座预训练研究的直接关联偏弱，更像是面向对齐/agent 的能力框架与评测+训练配方集合。但它提供了两类可迁移启发：
- 评测资产层面：把社会智能拆成结构化能力空间（多维度、多范式、共享场景控制变量），这类“诊断式 benchmark”思路可迁移到预训练阶段的能力剖面评估（而不只是单分数）。
- 训练闭环层面：强调“诊断→定向监督→on-policy 蒸馏→rubric RL→部署时外部支撑”的流水线，体现了 post-train 信号如何被组织成可迭代工程系统。若团队在做长期交互式 agent 或安全对齐，这套组织方式可能比单点算法更有用。
summary.technical_approach:
Zing（知境）由三块组成：
1) SoMBench：心理学启发的社会智能评测基准，把能力定义成结构化空间（3 个一级维度、17 个二级维度、71 种任务范式），并通过共享场景（284 个）控制题型、叙事视角、上下文长度等变量，减少“换题即换能力”的噪声。
2) 训练配方：用能力诊断来构造定向监督数据，然后做 SFT、on-policy distillation（更贴近交互分布）、以及基于 rubric 的强化学习来强化社会推理与行为选择。
3) Actio：部署时的 harness-controlled 架构，把推理所需的“类型化支撑”路由进来，包括程序性指导、运行时心智状态表示、可复用经验、外部社会/规范知识等，试图把一部分难以参数化的社会先验放到检索/工具/结构化记忆里。
整体取舍是：不把社会智能当成单一数据集或单一 reward，而是把它拆成可测的子能力，并在训练与推理时分别提供稳定支撑。
summary.experiments:
给定全文片段主要是框架与动机描述，未包含可核对的关键数值（例如：在 SoMBench 上相对哪些基线提升多少、训练各阶段的增益、Actio 的在线收益等）。从摘要信息可知 SoMBench 含 3,481 个实验任务（experiments）与 284 个共享场景，并控制多种元数据变量。若要判断其方法有效性，建议在全文中重点核对：
- SoMBench 的评分协议（自动/人工、rubric 细则、可靠性）与泄漏控制；
- 分阶段训练的消融：SFT vs on-policy distill vs rubric RL 的边际贡献；
- 部署时支撑（Actio）对长程交互稳定性的增益，以及是否引入新的失败模式（例如过度依赖外部规范库）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（30–45 分钟）：
- 先读 SoMBench 的能力空间定义与任务范式列表，判断它是否覆盖你关心的社会场景，控制变量是否合理。
- 再读训练配方章节的“数据如何从诊断来、rubric 如何写、on-policy 如何采样”，这是可复用的工程细节。
- 最后读 Actio 的系统设计：它更像部署架构提案，适合评估可实现性与维护成本。
如果只关心预训练：可以只取其“诊断式 benchmark 设计”方法论，训练与部署部分可快速略读。

summary_en.core_problem: How to turn “social intelligence” (mental-state inference, social relations and norms reasoning, context-sensitive behavior) from fragmented tasks into a diagnosable, trainable, and deployment-grounded stack for LLMs operating as long-term collaborators in human environments.
summary_en.importance: Weak direct linkage to base pretraining; it is closer to alignment/agent capability engineering (benchmark + training recipe + deployment harness). Still, it offers transferable ideas: (1) diagnostic benchmarking via a structured capability space and controlled shared scenarios—useful as a template for pretraining-stage capability profiling beyond single aggregate scores; (2) an explicit closed loop from diagnosis to targeted supervision, on-policy distillation, rubric-based RL, and inference-time supports, illustrating how post-training signals can be operationalized into an iterative system rather than a one-off fine-tune.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The work packages three components:
1) SoMBench: a psychology-grounded benchmark that defines social intelligence as a structured capability space (3 primary dimensions, 17 secondary dimensions, 71 task paradigms). It uses shared scenarios (284) and controls factors like question format, narrative perspective, and context length to reduce confounds.
2) Zing training recipe: capability diagnosis is used to construct targeted supervision, followed by SFT, on-policy distillation to better match interactive distributions, and rubric-based reinforcement learning to strengthen social reasoning and behavior.
3) Actio deployment harness: a harness-controlled architecture that routes typed supports into inference—procedural guidance, runtime mental-state representations, reusable experience, and external social/normative knowledge—explicitly offloading part of the “social priors” from parameters to structured retrieval/tools/memory.
The key design choice is to treat social intelligence as a layered capability with measurement, parametric internalization, and runtime grounding, rather than as a single dataset or reward.
summary_en.experiments: The provided excerpt is largely conceptual and does not include verifiable headline numbers (e.g., gains over baselines on SoMBench, stage-wise ablations, or online improvements from Actio). From the available text: SoMBench includes 3,481 experiments and 284 shared scenarios with controlled metadata. To assess effectiveness, the critical checks in the full paper are: (i) scoring protocol and reliability (rubrics, human/auto judging, leakage control), (ii) ablations across SFT vs on-policy distillation vs rubric RL, and (iii) deployment-time impact of Actio on long-horizon interaction stability and any new failure modes introduced by external normative knowledge.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
- Read the SoMBench capability taxonomy and task paradigms first; verify coverage and whether the controlled variables are well-motivated.
- Then read the training recipe details: how diagnosis maps to data construction, how rubrics are specified, and how on-policy sampling is done—these are the most reusable engineering parts.
- Finally read Actio as a deployment architecture proposal; evaluate feasibility and maintenance cost.
If your focus is strictly pretraining, treat this mainly as a diagnostic-benchmark design reference and skim the training/deployment sections.

recommendation.zh: 社会智能拆维度的 eval 设计可借鉴；训练 recipe 先当 post-train 弱信号，重点看错误分布而非总分。
recommendation.en: The social-intelligence decomposition is reusable for eval design; treat the training recipe as weak post-training signal and focus on error distributions, not aggregate score.

paper.title: CSPF: A Constrained Shared-Private Fusion Method for Non-Verifiable Preference Evaluation
paper.abstract: At present, reliable evaluation of non-verifiable tasks remains challenging. Existing approaches often fail to adequately capture the diverse evaluative criteria underlying human preferences in such tasks. To this end, we propose Constrained Shared-Private Fusion (CSPF), a fusion method that treats heterogeneous frozen reward models as complementary evaluators and learns to integrate their hidden-state representations under pairwise human-preference supervision. CSPF decomposes each expert signa

summary.core_problem: 解决非可验证任务中人类偏好评价不稳定的问题，尤其是单个 reward model 或简单多专家打分难以覆盖多样评价标准。
summary.importance: 贡献是 reward/preference modeling 方法。它尝试在 hidden-state 层面融合多个冻结 reward models，而不是只融合标量分数，对 RLHF/RLAIF 的 reward 信号质量有间接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Constrained Shared-Private Fusion。方法把多个冻结 reward model 视为互补评价器，在 pairwise human-preference supervision 下学习融合其 hidden-state representations，并把专家信号分解为 shared representation 和 expert-private representation，以同时保持跨专家对齐和互补视角。
summary.experiments: 在 LM-Arena target-domain adaptation 和 PPE out-of-distribution preference evaluation 上评估。摘要称 CSPF 在主要指标上优于单专家 reward model、标量分数多专家融合和 rubric-judge baselines，但未给出模型规模、数据规模和具体提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles unreliable preference evaluation for non-verifiable tasks, where single reward models or simple score aggregation fail to capture diverse human criteria.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a reward/preference modeling method. It fuses frozen reward models at the hidden-state level rather than aggregating scalar scores, which is relevant to the quality of reward signals in RLHF and RLAIF.
summary_en.technical_approach: CSPF treats heterogeneous frozen reward models as complementary evaluators. Under pairwise human-preference supervision, it learns to fuse their hidden-state representations while decomposing each expert signal into shared and expert-private components, preserving both alignment and complementary criteria.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on LM-Arena target-domain adaptation and PPE out-of-distribution preference evaluation. The abstract reports the best primary metrics against single-expert reward models, scalar-score multi-expert fusion, and rubric-judge baselines, without detailed model sizes, data scale, or exact gains.

recommendation.zh: reward fusion 的思路合理但偏工程；只看 shared/private 分解是否真比 logit/score ensemble 稳。
recommendation.en: The reward-fusion idea is plausible but engineering-heavy; skim whether the shared/private split truly beats logit or score ensembles.

paper.title: Best-of-Evidence: Best-of-N Selection under Partial Verification
paper.abstract: BoN improves model outputs by sampling several candidates and selecting one with a proxy score, but it assumes that complete candidates can be evaluated reliably. Many vision-language tasks instead provide only partial verification: a finding, span, value, region, or relation may be checkable even when no dependable whole-response verifier exists. Moreover, the same claim may recur across candidates with opposing stances, allowing one observation to support part of the pool and contradict anothe

summary.core_problem: 传统Best-of-N选择依赖完整响应的可靠评分，但多模态任务中常只有局部证据可验证，缺乏部分验证下的选择框架。
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次形式化部分验证下的BoN选择问题，提出证据最优选择框架。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Best-of-Evidence (BoE) 框架，保持候选池固定，用带符号的候选-因子图表示可复用断言，在有限验证预算下分配证据采集动作以优化最终选择，零预算时退化为标准BoN。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体实验设置、基准任务及量化效果数据，仅提供理论分析与框架设计。

summary_en.core_problem: Traditional Best-of-N selection assumes reliable full-response scoring, but many vision-language tasks only allow partial verification of local claims, lacking a formal selection framework under partial verification.
summary_en.importance: Methodological contribution that formalizes BoN selection under partial verification and proposes a best-of-evidence selection framework.
summary_en.technical_approach: BoE keeps the candidate pool fixed, represents reusable claims with a signed candidate-factor graph, and allocates a limited verification budget to evidence actions that improve the final selection; the zero-budget case recovers standard BoN.
summary_en.experiments: No concrete experimental setup, benchmark tasks, or quantitative results are provided in the abstract; the work focuses on theoretical framing.

recommendation.zh: 推理时BoN选择的理论扩展，对RL验证信号设计有弱启发，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: Theoretical extension of inference-time BoN selection with weak启发 for RL verification signal design; read abstract only.

paper.title: Reward-Free Evolving Agents via Pairwise Validator
paper.abstract: A self-evolving agentic loop repeatedly proposes a tweaked version of an agent (its prompt template or program) and accepts or rejects the change based on a per-iteration quality signal. Designing that signal is often the costly part of the project: a reliable scalar reward requires domain expertise and labeled examples that are themselves as expensive to assemble as the agent's underlying task. We propose replacing the scalar at the accept/reject gate with a pairwise validator: a frozen LLM tha

summary.core_problem: 自进化智能体循环的接受/拒绝门依赖人工设计的标量奖励，而奖励设计需要领域专业知识和昂贵的标注数据，很多场景下难以获取或成本过高。
summary.importance: 对预训练后对齐与智能体迭代优化有实际启发：无需训练的成对LLM验证器可替代昂贵的标量奖励，降低自进化系统的落地门槛，也为RL类方法中奖励信号的替代方案提供了可复用的实践路径。
summary.technical_approach: 提出两种无奖励验证方案，均用冻结LLM作为成对验证器，仅通过少量上下文示例对比父代与子代智能体（提示模板或代码）的优劣，输出二元判决：1）Adaptive Focus：仅替换接受/拒绝门，保留原有验证集奖励驱动的父代选择机制；2）Soft Elo：进一步用验证器判决构建Elo评分系统替代验证集奖励做父代选择，完全移除奖励依赖。两种方案均无需训练验证器参数。
summary.experiments: 在提示进化、代码进化两类载体、多个智能体与引擎配置下，多数基准测试中方法效果持平或超过使用完整标量奖励的自进化基线；配套消融实验验证了成对验证机制的有效性。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第1节的问题定义与图1的三类框架对比、第3节的两种变体设计逻辑、第4节的核心实验结果与关键消融，预计阅读时间20-30分钟。
summary.authors_note: 通讯作者 mh.liu.cs@gmail.com，机构未明确标注。

summary_en.core_problem: Self-evolving agent loops rely on hand-designed scalar rewards for the accept/reject gate, but reward engineering requires domain expertise and expensive labeled data, which is unavailable or cost-prohibitive in many real scenarios.
summary_en.importance: Offers practical insights for post-pretrain alignment and agent iteration: a training-free pairwise LLM validator can replace costly scalar rewards, lowering the barrier to deploying self-evolving systems, and provides a reusable alternative for reward signal design in RL-style pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes two reward-free validation variants, both using a frozen LLM as a pairwise validator that compares parent and child agent (prompt template or code) quality with a small number of in-context examples and returns a binary verdict: 1) Adaptive Focus: replaces only the accept/reject gate, retaining the existing val-set reward-driven parent selection; 2) Soft Elo: further replaces val-set reward parent selection with an Elo rating system built from validator verdicts, removing all reward dependency. Neither variant requires training the validator parameters.
summary_en.experiments: Across prompt evolution and code evolution substrates, multiple agent and engine setups, the method matches or outperforms full scalar reward self-evolution baselines on most benchmarks; extensive ablations validate the effectiveness of the pairwise validation mechanism.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 1 (problem framing + Figure 1 three-way framework comparison), Section 3 (design logic of the two variants), Section 4 (core results and key ablations). Estimated reading time: 20-30 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Corresponding author mh.liu.cs@gmail.com, institution not explicitly stated.

recommendation.zh: 用 LLM-as-a-Judge 做 Pairwise 比较来替代标量 Reward，思路不新，但集成到多个 Agent 进化框架中的工程实践值得参考，可看其 Prompt 设计和稳定性分析。
recommendation.en: Using LLM-as-a-Judge for pairwise comparison instead of scalar rewards is not novel, but its integration into multiple agent evolution frameworks offers practical engineering value. Worth skimming for prompt design and stability analysis.

paper.title: Learning Safe Agent Behaviour from Human Preferences and Justifications via World Models
paper.abstract: We address the problem of safely training an agent policy and deploying a good and safe policy, in settings where the environment dynamics are unknown and no suitable reward function is available. In the context of safety-critical environments, we consider traditional reinforcement learning impractical and resort to the resource of human input. We introduce DROPJ, a human-centred method for both safe training and deployment. We first learn a world model (a learned simulator) from a dataset of pr

summary.core_problem: 在环境动力学未知、无合适奖励函数的安全关键场景下，传统在线RL的随机探索会带来不可接受的风险，需安全训练和部署Agent策略的方法。
summary.importance: 提出结合世界模型与带理由人类偏好的安全Agent训练框架，避免真实环境中的不安全探索，为低数据安全关键场景的Agent训练提供新思路。
summary.technical_approach: 首先从离线真实轨迹学习世界模型（可学习模拟器）；人类在世界模型中交互生成模拟轨迹，采样轨迹段对并标注偏好及选择理由；基于带理由的偏好数据训练奖励模型，结合世界模型通过模型预测控制（MPC）直接部署策略。
summary.experiments: 摘要提及开展真实用户实验，但未披露具体环境、基线模型和量化效果（摘要截断）。

summary_en.core_problem: In safety-critical settings with unknown environment dynamics and no suitable reward function, random exploration in traditional online RL introduces unacceptable risks, requiring methods for safe training and deployment of agent policies.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a safe agent training framework combining world models with justified human preferences, avoiding unsafe exploration in the real environment, and provides a new approach for agent training in low-data, safety-critical scenarios.
summary_en.technical_approach: First learns a world model (learned simulator) from offline real-world trajectories; humans interact with the world model to generate simulated trajectories, sample trajectory segment pairs and annotate preferences along with justifications; trains a reward model on the justified preference data, and deploys policies via model predictive control (MPC) using the world model and reward model.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract mentions real-user experiments but does not disclose specific environments, baselines, or quantitative results (abstract truncated).

recommendation.zh: 传统安全RL工作，带理由的偏好奖励建模思路可备查，与LLM预训练/对齐关联较弱。
recommendation.en: A traditional safe RL work; the justified preference reward modeling idea is useful as background, but has weak relevance to LLM pretraining/alignment.

paper.title: Read It Back: Pretrained MLLMs Are Zero-Shot Reward Models for Text-to-Image Generation
paper.abstract: In this paper, we propose SpectraReward, a training-free reward function that turns pretrained MLLMs into off-the-shelf reward models for image-generation reinforcement learning. Instead of asking the MLLM to judge a generated image or answer decomposed verification questions, SpectraReward measures how well the original prompt can be recovered from the generated image through a single image-conditioned, teacher-forced forward pass. We use the average image-conditioned prompt log-likelihood as t

summary.core_problem: 文生图（含统一多模态模型的图像生成能力）的RL后训练阶段，现有奖励信号存在明显缺陷：基于人类偏好标注训练的奖励模型成本高、迭代慢；零样本使用MLLM做主观打分存在校准差、评分噪声大的问题；基于问题分解的验证方案工程复杂度高。目前缺乏高效、无需额外训练、开箱即用的可靠奖励信号，同时统一多模态模型如何不依赖外部组件、利用自身能力实现闭环自提升，也缺少成熟方案。
summary.importance: 提出的奖励计算方式直接复用预训练阶段的图像条件语言建模目标作为奖励，无需额外偏好标注或奖励模型微调，绕开了传统奖励模型的分布偏移问题。Self-SpectraReward的设计验证了奖励信号与策略模型的分布对齐，其重要性不低于奖励模型的规模——同模型内的对齐信号效果可以超过参数量大数十倍的外部奖励模型，这一发现不仅适用于多模态生成RL，对纯文本RL、自提升模型管线中如何构造无偏内置奖励也有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: SpectraReward是免训练奖励函数：将生成图像输入冻结的预训练MLLM，执行一次教师强制前向传播，计算原始prompt在图像条件下的平均token对数似然，将该值作为标量奖励。整个过程不需要MLLM输出显式的主观评分，也不需要将prompt拆分为原子问题逐一验证，直接复用MLLM预训练获得的图文对齐能力。针对同时集成视觉理解与图像生成的统一多模态模型，进一步设计Self-SpectraReward：直接使用模型自身的理解分支计算上述prompt对数似然，作为自身生成分支的奖励信号，不依赖任何外部模型形成闭环自提升。由于理解分支与生成分支共享tokenizer、视觉编码器和预训练数据分布，两者天然具备分布一致性，避免了外部奖励模型常见的分布偏移问题。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖两个生成骨干（SD3.5-M、BAGEL统一多模态模型）、三种RL算法、9个参数量从4B到235B的MLLM奖励骨干，在5个分布外文生图基准上完成评测：在BAGEL模型上，SpectraReward相对基线在TIIF-Bench上提升10.0分，GenEval上提升4.3分；相对之前的强基线AlphaGRPO，SpectraReward在TIIF-Bench上高6.3分，GenEval上高2.1分。Self-SpectraReward的效果优于使用同规模外部MLLM作为奖励的SpectraReward，甚至与使用4倍到30倍参数量外部MLLM的SpectraReward效果相当或更好——例如相对使用最优外部MLLM骨干的SpectraReward，Self-SpectraReward在GenEval上高1.2分、GenEval2上高2.1分、WISE上高2.0分，验证了奖励与策略的分布对齐的价值不低于奖励模型规模。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时重点关注核心奖励设计思路（教师强制计算prompt对数似然，而非让模型显式打分）、Self-SpectraReward的闭环设计逻辑，以及分布对齐与奖励模型规模的对比实验结论，可跳过RL算法实现的低层细节。预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Reinforcement learning post-training for text-to-image generation (including generation capabilities in unified multimodal models) lacks efficient, training-free, reliable reward signals. Reward models trained on human preference annotations are costly to build and slow to iterate; zero-shot MLLM judges suffer from poor calibration and high scoring noise; question-decomposition based verification pipelines introduce high engineering complexity. There is also no mature approach for unified multimodal models to achieve closed-loop self-improvement using only internal capabilities, without external dependencies.
summary_en.importance: The proposed reward formulation directly reuses the pretrained image-conditioned language modeling objective as a reward signal, eliminating the need for preference annotations or dedicated reward model fine-tuning, and avoiding common distribution shift issues in traditional reward models. The Self-SpectraReward design demonstrates that distributional alignment between reward signal and policy is at least as important as reward model scale: an aligned internal reward can outperform external reward models tens of times larger. This finding is relevant not just for multimodal generation RL, but also for text-only RL and self-improving model pipelines seeking to build unbiased, built-in reward signals.
summary_en.technical_approach: SpectraReward is a training-free reward function that works by passing a generated image to a frozen pretrained MLLM, running a single teacher-forced forward pass on the original text prompt, and using the mean token log-likelihood of the prompt conditioned on the image as the scalar reward. This process requires no explicit scalar judgment from the MLLM, and no decomposition of prompts into atomic verification questions; it directly leverages the image-text alignment capability learned during MLLM pretraining. For unified multimodal models that integrate both visual understanding and image generation in a single architecture, Self-SpectraReward uses the model’s own understanding branch to compute the prompt log-likelihood reward for its generation branch, forming a closed-loop self-improvement pipeline with no external model dependencies. The understanding and generation branches share a tokenizer, vision encoder, and pretraining data distribution, creating natural distributional alignment that avoids shift issues common with external reward models.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluations are conducted across two generator backbones (SD3.5-M, BAGEL unified multimodal model), three RL algorithms, and 9 MLLM reward backbones spanning 4B to 235B parameters, on 5 out-of-distribution text-to-image benchmarks. On the BAGEL model, SpectraReward improves over the base model by +10.0 on TIIF-Bench and +4.3 on GenEval; it outperforms the strong AlphaGRPO baseline by +6.3 on TIIF-Bench and +2.1 on GenEval. Self-SpectraReward outperforms SpectraReward with similarly sized external MLLM backbones, and matches or exceeds performance of SpectraReward using 4x to 30x larger external MLLMs: for example, it delivers +1.2 on GenEval, +2.1 on GenEval2, and +2.0 on WISE over the best-performing external MLLM backbone for SpectraReward, confirming that distributional alignment between reward and policy delivers as much value as increased reward model scale.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on the core reward design choice (prompt log-likelihood under teacher forcing, rather than explicit model scoring), the closed-loop Self-SpectraReward setup, and the experimental result comparing distributional alignment to reward model scale. Low-level RL algorithm implementation details can be skipped. Expected reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和失败案例：prompt likelihood 当 reward 很干净，但要警惕它学到的是 caption recoverability 而非偏好。
recommendation.en: Read the method and failure cases: prompt likelihood is a clean reward signal, but it may optimize caption recoverability rather than human preference.

paper.title: Selective Timestep Weighting and Advantage-Based Replay for Sample-Efficient Diffusion RLHF
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for aligning generative models with human preferences. However, applying RLHF to diffusion models remains highly feedback inefficient, as existing approaches typically require large amounts of human or reward model evaluations. This limitation reduces the practicality of diffusion RLHF in realworld settings where feedback is the primary bottleneck. In this paper, we propose two complementary strategies that subs

summary.core_problem: 解决扩散模型 RLHF 中反馈样本效率低、需要大量人工或 reward model 评估的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是面向扩散生成模型后训练的反馈效率改进。它不直接研究 LLM 预训练，但“轨迹中不同 step 的 reward 信息量不均匀”这个观察，对 diffusion LM、离散扩散语言模型和 RLVR 中的 credit assignment 有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出两类互补策略：选择性 timestep weighting，对去噪过程中的不同时间步按信息量重新加权；advantage-based replay，优先复用高价值或高优势的轨迹样本。核心思想是避免把 reward 信号均匀分配到所有 denoising steps 和所有轨迹上。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体生成任务、模型规模、reward model、人工反馈规模、baseline 和提升幅度。能确认的是目标是在保持 unseen prompts 泛化的同时减少反馈评估次数。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to improve feedback efficiency in RLHF for diffusion models, where reward or human evaluations are expensive.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a post-training method for diffusion generative models. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but the observation that reward information is unevenly distributed across trajectory steps is relevant to diffusion LMs, discrete denoising language models, and RL-style credit assignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method combines selective timestep weighting, which reweights denoising steps by their learning utility, with advantage-based replay, which prioritizes informative trajectories. The main idea is to avoid assigning reward signal uniformly across all denoising steps and samples.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide the exact generation tasks, model sizes, reward models, feedback budget, baselines, or quantitative gains. It claims improved feedback efficiency while preserving generalization to unseen prompts.

recommendation.zh: 读 abstract 和方法公式就够；若做 diffusion LM 的 RL credit assignment，可把 timestep weighting 当候选 ablation。
recommendation.en: Read the abstract and the weighting equations; for diffusion-LM RL credit assignment, timestep weighting is worth one ablation.

paper.title: Safe Inference-Time Alignment via Lagrangian Reward Augmentation
paper.abstract: Inference-time alignment steers a frozen language model during decoding using auxiliary reward signals, avoiding the cost of repeated weight updates. However, existing inference-time alignment methods typically optimize a single scalar score, so explicit safety constraints must either be ignored or encoded through manually tuned penalties. We propose Lagrangian Reward Augmentation (LARA), a general inference-time alignment framework under safety constraints. Starting from a KL-regularized constr

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是推理时对齐中的安全约束问题。现有 inference-time alignment 通常把 helpfulness 和 safety 合成一个手工调权的标量分数，缺少从显式安全预算推导 decoding objective 的机制。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练方法论文，但对 pretrain-posttrain 接口有参考意义。它把 Safe RLHF 的约束优化形式迁移到推理阶段，使冻结模型也能在 reward 和 cost 之间做可校准的权衡。对基座研究更有启发的是训练信号质量问题：reward model 和 cost model 不只是 RL 微调信号，也可以成为推理时控制信号；安全约束的表达方式会影响模型行为，即使权重完全不更新。
summary.technical_approach: LARA 从 KL-regularized constrained objective 出发：在保持策略不偏离参考模型太远的前提下最大化 reward，同时约束 expected cost 不超过给定安全预算。论文对安全约束做 Lagrangian dualization，引入非负乘子 λ，把目标转成 augmented reward：rλ(x,y)=r(x,y)-λc(x,y)。这样原问题被化为关于 λ 的一维凸校准问题。λ 在一个小 calibration set 上估计，之后可以直接插入已有推理时对齐方法。对 Best-of-N 这类 sequence-level reranking，LARA 有清晰的 expected-cost constrained optimum 解释：采样多个候选后用增强奖励选择，同时 λ 对应安全预算。对 token-level reward-guided decoding，LARA 提供的是由同一约束目标诱导出的启发式打分。论文还分析了 dual objective 的几何性质，证明 dual gradient 具有单调性，因此可以用 binary search 高效校准 λ，并给出有限样本估计保证。
summary.experiments: 实验显示，LARA 改善了 helpfulness-harmlessness tradeoff。在推理时方法中，Best-of-N 配合 LARA 表现最好，并接近基于微调的 direct alignment baseline。结果也表明，单纯手工设置 reward-cost penalty 不够稳健；把 λ 通过约束目标和 calibration set 来确定，可以更稳定地满足安全预算。给定内容未包含具体 benchmark、模型规模和数值表，因此只能确认趋势，不能判断收益幅度和跨模型泛化强度。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议用 20–30 分钟。先看 problem formulation，确认 reward、cost、KL 正则和 safety budget 的定义。然后重点看 dualization 部分，理解为什么只剩一个非负 λ，以及 augmented reward 如何接入 Best-of-N 和 token-level decoder。理论部分可只看 dual gradient monotonicity 和 finite-sample guarantee 的结论。实验部分重点看 helpfulness-harmlessness frontier、不同 inference-time methods 的比较、λ calibration 对安全预算满足率的影响。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies safe inference-time alignment for frozen language models. Existing decoding-time methods usually optimize a single scalar score, so safety has to be ignored or folded in through manually tuned penalties. LARA asks how to derive that score from an explicit safety constraint.
summary_en.importance: This is an alignment and inference-time control paper rather than a pretraining paper. Its relevance to foundation-model research is in the interface between training signals and deployment-time behavior. Reward and cost models can be used not only for policy updates but also for constrained decoding. The work also makes clear that the form of the safety signal matters: even with fixed model weights, the choice of constraint and calibration procedure changes the helpfulness-safety tradeoff.
summary_en.technical_approach: LARA starts from a KL-regularized constrained objective: maximize reward while keeping the expected cost below a safety budget and regularizing against a reference policy. The safety constraint is dualized with a nonnegative multiplier λ, yielding an augmented reward rλ(x,y)=r(x,y)-λc(x,y). The main technical move is to reduce the constrained problem to a one-dimensional convex calibration problem over λ. The multiplier is estimated on a small calibration set and then reused as the scoring rule during decoding. For sequence-level Best-of-N reranking, this has a direct expected-cost constrained interpretation. For token-level reward-guided decoding, it becomes a principled heuristic derived from the same constrained objective. The paper also proves monotonicity of the dual gradient, which supports binary-search calibration, and gives a finite-sample guarantee for estimating the multiplier.
summary_en.experiments: The reported experiments show better helpfulness-harmlessness tradeoffs than manually chosen scalar penalties. Among inference-time methods, Best-of-N with LARA performs best and approaches finetuning-based direct-alignment baselines. The key empirical claim is that calibrating λ from a constrained objective is more stable than manually tuning reward-cost weights. The provided content does not include exact model sizes, datasets, or numerical tables, so the strength of the gains should be verified from the full experimental section.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim should take about 20–30 minutes. Read the objective formulation first, especially the definitions of reward, cost, KL regularization, and safety budget. Then read the dual derivation and the calibration algorithm for λ. The most useful experimental plots are likely the helpfulness-harmlessness frontier, the comparison between Best-of-N and token-level guided decoding, and the analysis of constraint satisfaction after calibration. The theory section can be read selectively: focus on the monotone dual gradient and the finite-sample calibration result.

recommendation.zh: 推理时对齐的干净方法，对偶化处理多约束的思路可迁移到预训练多目标优化，重点看§3的对偶推导与校准集设计
recommendation.en: Clean inference-time alignment method; Lagrangian dual formulation for multi-constraint optimization is transferable to multi-objective pretraining, focus on §3 derivation and calibration set design

paper.title: LLM-as-a-Tutor: Policy-Aware Prompt Adaptation for Non-Verifiable RL
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) for non-verifiable instruction following increasingly relies on LLM judges with prompt-specific rubrics as reward signals. While recent methods adapt these rubrics to the evolving policy during training, the training prompts themselves remain static, drawn from fixed corpora. This static approach often results in a critical misalignment between prompt difficulty and policy capability, leaving the judge unable to recover a discriminative reward signal when prompts fail

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文讨论非可验证任务 RL 中的训练提示词失配问题：如果 prompt 对当前 policy 太简单或太难，即使 LLM judge 和 rubric 质量不错，也无法在 rollout 之间产生有用的奖励差异。
summary.importance: 它对预训练研究的直接影响有限，但对 post-train 训练信号质量有参考意义。关键启发是：非可验证 RL 的瓶颈不只在 reward model 或 judge，也在 prompt 是否处在当前模型能力边界附近。这个问题和课程学习、数据难度调度、RL 数据合成有关，也会影响后续把 RL 信号反哺到 mid-train 或 continual pretrain 的设计。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 LLM-as-a-Tutor。一个 tutor LLM 同时承担 examiner 和 generator 两个角色。每个 seed prompt 先由 tutor 生成 base rubric，后续训练中保持 seed prompt 和 base rubric 的主体稳定。每轮迭代时，examiner 从当前 policy 对同一 prompt 的两个 rollout 中做 pairwise comparison，判断它们是否存在质量差异。如果两个回答质量不可区分，说明该 prompt 对当前 policy 不够有训练信号；generator 就给 prompt 追加一个原子约束，并同步给 rubric 追加对应评价标准。设计上选择追加而不是重写，是为了保持原始数据分布和任务语义，同时单调提高要求数量。它和只做 policy-adaptive rubric 的方法不同：当 prompt 本身无法激发质量方差时，再细的 rubric 也难以恢复奖励信号，必须改变 prompt。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 Qwen3-1.7B 作为 policy，Qwen3-8B 作为 tutor，在 FollowBench、AdvancedIF 和 InfoBench 三个复杂指令遵循 benchmark 上评估。方法平均分高于固定 prompt 训练基线，包括 base rubrics、WildChecklists 和 policy-adaptive rubrics；也高于会修改 prompt 的基线，如 Evol-Instruct 和 EVA。消融显示，policy-aware 的定向追加约束优于无条件追加、随机追加，以及基于更强模型回答来判断是否追加；追加约束也优于整体重写 prompt。分析还显示，tutor 的 pairwise judgment 与经验难度相关，每个追加约束都会放大奖励可区分性，且随着 policy 规模增大，需要修改的 prompt 比例单调上升。给出的材料没有包含具体分数表。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20 到 30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 policy-prompt mismatch 的定义，Method 中 examiner/generator 的调用流程，以及 Ablation 部分。若关注 RLHF/RLAIF 数据构造，可以重点看为什么 policy-adaptive rubric 不够，以及追加约束为什么比重写 prompt 稳定。若只关注基座预训练，可快速浏览实验，把它当作 post-train 奖励方差和课程数据选择的一个案例。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies prompt-policy mismatch in RL for non-verifiable instruction following. If a prompt is too easy or too hard for the current policy, rollouts have little quality variation, so even a capable LLM judge with a prompt-specific rubric cannot produce a useful reward signal.
summary_en.importance: The work is more relevant to post-training than to base pretraining, but it is useful for understanding training-signal quality. Its main lesson is that non-verifiable RL can fail because of the prompt distribution, not only because of reward-model weakness. Prompts need to stay near the policy’s competence frontier. This connects to curriculum design, synthetic instruction generation, and future attempts to feed RL-derived signals back into mid-training or continual pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: LLM-as-a-Tutor uses a single tutor model in two roles. As an examiner, it performs pairwise comparison between two rollouts from the current policy and decides whether their quality is distinguishable. As a generator, it modifies a non-challenging prompt by appending an atomic constraint and adding the corresponding rubric criterion. Each seed prompt receives a base rubric once, and the method keeps the seed prompt and base rubric largely intact while adding constraints when needed. The choice of appending rather than rewriting is deliberate: it preserves the source task distribution while increasing difficulty in a controlled way. Compared with policy-adaptive rubrics, the method changes the prompt itself when the original prompt cannot elicit reward variance.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use Qwen3-1.7B as the policy and Qwen3-8B as the tutor. Evaluation is conducted on FollowBench, AdvancedIF, and InfoBench. LLM-as-a-Tutor outperforms fixed-prompt baselines such as base rubrics, WildChecklists, and policy-adaptive rubrics, as well as prompt-modification baselines such as Evol-Instruct and EVA. Ablations indicate that targeted policy-aware constraint appending is better than unconditional appending, random appending, or adapting prompts based on a stronger model’s responses. Appending constraints also works better than rewriting prompts. The analysis shows that the tutor’s pairwise judgments correlate with empirical difficulty, that appended constraints increase reward discriminativeness, and that the prompt modification rate rises with policy scale. The provided material does not include the full numerical score table.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim read should take about 20 to 30 minutes. Focus on the problem formulation in the introduction, the examiner-generator loop in the method section, and the ablations comparing targeted appending with random, unconditional, and rewrite-based variants. For researchers working on RLHF or RLAIF data pipelines, the most useful part is the argument that rubric adaptation alone cannot rescue prompts that fail to induce rollout variance. For base-model pretraining, it is mainly a case study in curriculum construction and reward-signal selection.

recommendation.zh: RL训练中prompt难度自适应的思路对后训练课程设计有参考价值，重点看奖励信号区分度的测量方法与消融。
recommendation.en: The adaptive prompt difficulty idea in RL training is useful for post-training curriculum design; focus on reward discriminability measurement and ablations.

paper.title: Many Voices, One Reward: Multi-Role Rubric Generation for LLM Judging and Reward Modeling
paper.abstract: Reliable reward and preference signals are critical for evaluating and optimizing large language models on open-ended tasks. Rubric-based judges offer a transparent way to decompose such judgments into explicit evaluation criteria, but existing annotation-free rubric generators typically rely on a single generic evaluator. As a result, they may overlook important dimensions of human preference, a failure mode we term dimensional blind spots. To address this limitation, we propose Multi-Role Rubr

summary.core_problem: 论文关注开放式任务中的 judge 和 reward 信号构造问题：单个通用 evaluator 自动生成 rubric 时，经常漏掉人类偏好的某些维度，导致打分在不同领域不稳定，也给模型留下针对 rubric 的投机空间。
summary.importance: 这篇论文更偏 post-training 和 evaluation，但对预训练研究仍有间接价值。预训练之后的 SFT、RLHF、RLVR 都依赖 reward 或 preference 信号；如果信号只覆盖部分质量维度，模型会学习到狭窄目标，甚至放大 reward hacking。MRRG 的启发是，reward 质量不只来自更强的 judge model，也来自评价维度是否完整、是否可审计。对研究 pretrain-posttrain 接口的人来说，它提供了一个低成本构造可解释 reward 的方案。
summary.technical_approach: 方法名为 Multi-Role Rubric Generation，简称 MRRG。它不训练新的 reward model，也不需要参考答案或人工标注。给定输入 prompt 后，系统让同一个 LLM 扮演多个互补评价角色，例如 user、domain expert、educator、AI researcher、linguist。每个角色生成短小、原子化、可验证的 rubric item。随后系统把这些 item 汇总、去重，形成一个可审计的 rubric scorer。评分时，LLM 按每条 criterion 对候选回答打分，再聚合成标量 reward。这个 scorer 既可用于 pairwise preference validation，也可直接作为 GRPO-style RLVR 的 reward。
summary.experiments: 实验在 RewardBench-2、JudgeBench 和 PPE 上验证 judge 质量，覆盖 Qwen2.5 和 GPT 系列模型。论文报告 MRRG 相比最强列出 baseline 有 3.1 到 16.4 个百分点提升。用于 GRPO-style RLVR 时，MRRG 相比最强 single-voice reward baseline 在 BiGGen Bench 上提升 1.7 分，在 HealthBench-Hard 上提升 3.4 分。引言中的 NASDAQ 示例展示了 single-voice rubric 容易奖励表面完成度，却漏掉可行性、认知校准和不可验证声明等维度。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20 到 30 分钟。先看 Introduction 中 dimensional blind spots 和 rubric hacking 的定义，以及 Figure 1、Table 1 的失败案例。方法部分重点看 2.2 到 2.4：多角色如何生成 rubric，如何去重聚合，如何作为 judge 和 GRPO reward 共用。实验部分看 RewardBench-2、JudgeBench、PPE 的总体表格，以及 RLVR 部分是否真的改善下游 reward optimization。若只关心预训练，可跳过大部分 prompt 细节，保留对 reward 信号覆盖面的理解。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to build reliable rubric-based judges and reward signals for open-ended LLM outputs without human annotations or reference answers.
